tagline: Synthesized snare from a pitched tone plus noise
description: A synthesized snare drum: a triangle-wave body with a downward pitch sweep, a filtered-noise rattle and a short noise click, mixed and soft-clipped. Any MIDI note triggers the same one-shot hit, scaled by velocity, with up to four overlapping hits.

features.name: Pitch Env
features.description: Starts the body up to three times higher and drops it to Tone over about 30 ms.

features.name: Snappy and Snare Decay
features.description: Level of the noise rattle and its decay time, 10 to 500 ms.

features.name: Decay
features.description: Decay time of the tonal body, 10 ms to 1 s.

features.name: Snap
features.description: Level of a 2 ms noise click at the start of the hit.
